title: AVG
definition:
Returns the average value of a numeric column.
The function calculates the sum of all values and divides it by the number of rows.

title: COUNT
definition:
Returns the number of rows in a dataset or the number of non-null values in a column.
This function is commonly used to count records.

examples.title: Using COUNT as a column (GROUP BY)

title: SUM
definition:
Returns the total sum of a numeric column.
The function adds all values from the specified column.

examples.title: Using SUM as a column (GROUP BY)

title: MIN
definition:
Returns the smallest value from a column.
This function is useful for finding minimum values such as the lowest price.

title: MAX
definition:
Returns the largest value from a column.
This function is useful for finding maximum values such as the highest price.

title: MEDIAN
definition:
Returns the median value of a numeric column.
The median is the middle value when all values are ordered from lowest to highest.
If the number of values is even, the median is calculated as the average of the two middle values.
This is useful for understanding the central tendency of data without being affected by extreme values.

examples.title: Complex : Compare price distribution by category

title: PERCENTILE_CONT
definition:
Returns the continuous percentile value of a numeric column.
The percentile is calculated by ordering the values and interpolating between them when necessary.
The parameter must be a value between 0 and 1, where 0.5 represents the median.
This function is useful for statistical analysis and distribution measurements.

title: PERCENTILE_DISC
definition:
Returns the discrete percentile value of a numeric column.
The function selects the first actual value whose position matches or exceeds the requested percentile.
Unlike PERCENTILE_CONT, no interpolation is performed.
The parameter must be a value between 0 and 1.
